# Atom Shop Update August 12, 2025

![Atom Shop Update August 12, 2025](/uploads/545_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Starting August 12th, the Corvega Car Dealership Pack and the Mr. Handy Fireworks Pack will be available in the shop for a limited time.

Item Atoms Corvega Car Dealership Pack 1,500 Mr. Handy Fireworks Pack 1,800 Corvega Car Dealership 700 Cherrybomb Ride Machine 500 AutoVend Vending Machine 500 Corvega Runner 250 Corvega Poster Set 300 Mr. Handy's Cake Maker 500 Fireworks Launcher 500 #### Weekly Deals

This week the Atomic Shop is back with daily offers! Each item is always available until 6:00 p.m. CEST the following day.
